This '''[[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]''' was hired by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]] in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]] to fight in the [[Battle of Gazzari]]. During the battle, the mercenary positioned his [[Brock-Eight cannon]]s on the northern ridge of a crater, and helped to bombard the [[Death Spiral]] in the crater.
